title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1981-09-12
lineage: Adobe Audition, iZoptope Ozone, CD Wave, shorten used
source: Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC D-5; and then aud (unknown mics, probably Sony ECM-33P x2) >Sony D5 > unknown reel generations (no more than 2) > Sony R500 DAT >CD (via HHb-850)

ai_review.summary: Clean audience recording with natural sound, but little information on the performance
ai_review.review: The tape, sourced from two Nakamichi microphones feeding a Sony TC‑D5 cassette deck (Dolby B) and later digitized, is praised for its natural and clean sonic character. No details about the concert itself are provided, leaving the musical quality unclear.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review; it rates the recording as natural and clean (good) but gives an overall 3‑star rating, with no commentary on the show itself.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Two Nakamichi mics > Sony TC‑D5 (Dolby B) chain; described as most natural and clean despite being an audience source.
